name: sessions
title: Sessions
description: Every Claude Code, Codex and Copilot CLI session on this machine and what each is doing: working, your turn, waiting on you, or ended. Enter brings the session's terminal to the front.
author: pal

settings.label: Agents
settings.description: Which agents' files are read: claude, codex, copilot.

settings.label: Ended sessions shown for
settings.description: A session with no process behind it stays listed as ended this long after its last write, so a crash is seen; older ones are only under the Recent filter.

settings.label: Recent filter
settings.description: How far back the Recent filter lists sessions to resume.

settings.label: Terminal
settings.description: Where Focus looks for the session's window and what Resume opens. Auto tries a tmux pane, then kitty, iTerm2, Terminal, WezTerm, then raises the app the process runs under by its pid; a named one tries tmux then that alone; tmux only stops after the pane.

settings.label: Editor
settings.description: The command Open in editor and Open transcript run (found on PATH, then in Homebrew's and ~/.local/bin); the OS opener when it is not found.

state.description: Record a session's state from a hook, for ten minutes, over what the files say

session.description: The session id the CLI gave the hook

state.description: working, waiting (your turn) or blocked (a prompt is up)

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Every session by state: waiting on you, your turn, working, ended. The pane shows the last exchange and, for a blocked one, the tool call left hanging.

keys.title: Focus the session's terminal (an ended one: resume it in a new terminal)
Send the line typed in the bar to a session in a tmux pane
The transcript as a view: the last entries as a chat, [ for older, c copies the reply, s sends a line over tmux
Open the transcript in the editor
Open the folder in the editor
Kill the process (asks first; works on marked rows)

working.description: Sessions with a turn in progress

waiting.description: Sessions waiting on you (your turn, or blocked on a permission)

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: How many sessions are running, with red !N waiting on you, amber ·N your turn, blue …N working; an alarm while one is waiting on you; hidden with none. The popover lists them by state: Enter focuses the terminal, o opens the transcript, r copies the resume command, x kills.

attention.title: One waiting on you, one your turn

item.tooltip: 2 sessions: 1 waiting on you, 1 your turn
5 sessions: 1 waiting on you, 1 your turn, 2 working, 1 ended

keys.title: Focus the session's terminal (an ended one: resume it)
The transcript as a view over the list
Open the transcript in the editor
Open the palette on a tmux session's row, to type a line into it
Move between sessions (or j and k)

store.tagline: Every Claude Code, Codex and Copilot session, and which one needs you
features: One row per session, sorted by who needs you: waiting on you, your turn, working, ended
Spots a session stuck on a permission prompt; a hook can report the exact state
The last prompt, the last reply, the pending command, the model, folder, branch and token count
`enter` jumps to the session's terminal (tmux, kitty, iTerm2, Terminal, WezTerm); an ended one resumes
`cmd+t` reads the transcript live in the panel; send a line to a tmux session with `cmd+enter`
A bar item counts sessions by state and raises an alarm while one waits on you

screenshots.caption: Every Claude Code, Codex and Copilot session on the machine by state: the one waiting on you first, then your turn, working, ended
The pane: your last prompt, the agent's last words and the command it is waiting to run; the folder, tokens and process below
cmd+t reads the transcript inside pal: prompts, replies and every tool call with its outcome, live while it runs
⌘K on a session: focus its terminal, send a line to its tmux pane, read or reveal the transcript, copy the resume command
On the menu bar: how many sessions wait on you, are your turn and are working; the glyph turns red while one waits on you
A click opens the popover: a row per session by state; Enter focuses its terminal, r copies the resume command
t shows the transcript over the list, the command waiting on you lit
On sketchybar: the three counts in red, amber and blue

actions.title: Focus the terminal
actions.description: The window the session runs in, in front; a tmux pane is selected on the way.

actions.title: Resume in a terminal
actions.description: On an ended session: a terminal opens in its folder running the resume command.

actions.title: Send the line
actions.description: On a session in a tmux pane: the bar's text typed into it and sent.

actions.title: Transcript
actions.description: The conversation as a view inside pal, live while the session runs.

actions.title: Open transcript in the editor
actions.description: The transcript file in the editor named in Settings, else the OS's text editor.

actions.title: Open in editor
actions.description: The session's folder in the editor named in Settings, Finder when it is not on PATH.

actions.title: Copy resume command
actions.description: The CLI's own resume line for this session.

actions.title: Kill
actions.description: SIGTERM to the session's process, after a confirm; the transcript stays.
